description: Go backend: SBOM project/version management, scanning, diff detection, webhook user-scoping, and API endpoints. This is the core backend implementation covering the internal/sbommon package (SBOM monitoring logic), updates to the webhook system for user-scoping, API routes, and CLI commands.
steps: Create internal/sbommon/ package (SBOM monitoring) with model types: SBOMProject, SBOMVersion, SBOMScanResult, ScanFinding (reuse audit.Finding structure), ScanDiff (new_findings []ScanFinding, resolved_findings []ScanFinding).

Create internal/sbommon/store.go with SBOMStore interface: CreateProject, GetProject, ListProjects (by user_id), UpdateProject, DeleteProject, CreateVersion, GetVersion, ListVersions (by project_id), GetLatestVersion, CreateScanResult, GetScanResult, ListScanResults (by version_id), GetLatestScanResult (by version_id), GetPreviousScanResult (by version_id, before given scan_id).
Create internal/sbommon/postgres.go implementing SBOMStore with database/sql + pgx stdlib, following patterns from internal/webhook/store.go and internal/watchlist/postgres.go.

Create internal/sbommon/scanner.go with Scanner struct that: (1) takes a VulnStore (audit.VulnStore interface) as dependency, (2) has Scan(ctx, sbomData []byte) method that parses SBOM via internal/sbom.Parse(), runs audit via internal/audit.Auditor, returns SBOMScanResult, (3) has ScanVersion(ctx, version *SBOMVersion) that loads raw_sbom from version and runs Scan, (4) has ComputeDiff(current, previous *SBOMScanResult) that compares findings to identify new and resolved vulnerabilities.
Create internal/sbommon/scanner_test.go with unit tests for Scanner.Scan (mock VulnStore), ComputeDiff logic (table-driven: no previous scan, new findings added, findings resolved, mixed).

Create internal/sbommon/handlers.go with HTTP handlers following internal/watchlist/handlers.go pattern: HandleCreateProject, HandleListProjects, HandleGetProject, HandleDeleteProject, HandleUploadSBOM (creates version + runs scan, returns result), HandleListVersions, HandleListScanResults, HandleGetScanResult, HandleGetScanDiff (compares two scan results or current vs previous).
Create internal/sbommon/handlers_test.go with unit tests for handlers using httptest, mock store.
Update internal/model/webhook.go: add UserID *int64 field to Webhook struct.

Update internal/webhook/store.go: (1) modify CreateWebhook SQL to include user_id, (2) modify UpdateWebhook to include user_id, (3) add ListWebhooksByUser(ctx, userID int64) method that filters by user_id, (4) modify GetWebhook to accept optional userID parameter or add GetWebhookByUser, (5) modify GetWebhooksByEvent to accept optional userID for scoping, (6) update all Scan calls to include user_id field.

Update internal/server/webhook.go handlers to use auth.UserFromContext to scope webhook CRUD to the authenticated user (following the watchlist pattern). Existing webhooks with NULL user_id remain accessible to admins.
Update internal/server/server.go routes() to register the new SBOM monitoring endpoints under /api/v1/sbom/ with auth middleware. Wire SBOMStore and Scanner as dependencies in server.Config.

Create internal/sbommon/ingest_hook.go implementing an IngestSBOMReEvaluator that satisfies a callback interface: after ingest completes, it queries all sbom_versions, re-scans them, computes diffs, and fires webhooks for 'sbom_new_finding' events if new vulnerabilities are detected.
Update internal/ingest/ingest.go to add a WithSBOMReEvaluator option that fires after consumeBatches completes (similar to WithWebhookNotifier pattern).

Create cmd/mayu/sbom.go with CLI commands: 'mayu sbom upload --project <name> --version <ver> --sbom <path> [--environment <env>]' (uploads SBOM, creates project if needed, runs scan), 'mayu sbom scan --project <name> [--version <ver>]' (re-scans latest or specified version), 'mayu sbom list [--project <name>]' (lists projects or versions).
Update cmd/mayu/main.go to add 'sbom' command dispatch.
Update cmd/mayu/serve.go to wire SBOMStore, Scanner, and IngestSBOMReEvaluator into the server config and ingest pipeline.
Create internal/sbommon/store_test.go with unit tests for PostgreSQL store methods (using mock/interface testing where possible).
Update internal/webhook/store_test.go to cover the new user_id-aware methods.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'make build' succeeds with all new code compiling
Running 'make test' passes all unit tests including new ones in internal/sbommon/ and updated webhook tests
The SBOM monitoring store interface covers CRUD for projects, versions, and scan results
The Scanner correctly uses the existing audit.Auditor for vulnerability matching
The diff detection correctly identifies new findings (in current but not previous) and resolved findings (in previous but not current)
Webhook CRUD is user-scoped (handlers use auth.UserFromContext)
CLI 'mayu sbom' subcommands are registered in main.go
API routes for /api/v1/sbom/* are registered in server.go
verification: Run 'make test' to confirm all tests pass
findings: All steps completed. Build and tests pass. Key patterns followed: user-scoped CRUD via auth.UserFromContext, database/sql with pgx stdlib, TDD with table-driven tests. The webhook user_id column is nullable for backward compatibility with existing webhooks. The ingest hook uses context.WithoutCancel for non-blocking goroutine execution.
